integrity: Universal proof uses Gale evenness, explicit combinatorial connectivity paths, parity invariant and graph Euler characteristic; finite independent exact checker is corroborative, not an infinite proof. Full primary manuscript compared to the theorem statement. Self-review passed; no independent audit or validation has been performed.
limitations: Ordinary homotopy classification for the double of the cyclic four-polytope boundary only. The n=5 matching-complex base case is known. No full equivariant homotopy type, degree-one symmetry representation or result for arbitrary 3-spheres is established. A matching result in unindexed literature may exist.
title: Parity disconnects doubles of cyclic four-polytope boundaries
